notes.title: Barber Party Demo: Fresh New Graphics Update is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Barbers![/h3]
We're thrilled that you've been enjoying the demo of Barber Party! Here at Second Wind Games, we're working hard to create a truly fun and engaging party game experience for you all.

With our latest update, we're excited to introduce some visual upgrades for our beloved clients. Bianca, Woolia, Steve, and Bunio are looking fresher than ever, and we can't wait for you to check out their improved styles in the updated demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45153896/e05ce94bf4548b09aeebd68dadbde2779a255ed2.png[/img]

[h3]We've also noticed some of you have questions about online co-op.[/h3] 
While the full version of Barber Party will feature complete online multiplayer with crossplay support, the current demo can only be played locally or online using Steam Remote Play.

Stay tuned for more updates in the near future!

[i]Second Wind Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Official Discord Server
notes.content:
Hello Barbers!

Party games are all about having fun together, and in [b]Barber Party[/b], tossing a client wouldn’t be half as fun without another barber to catch them! That’s why we’re inviting you to join a space that celebrates the most important part of any party game — you.

We’re excited to announce the launch of our [b]Discord server[/b], and we’d love to have you there! It’s the perfect place to stay connected, share your thoughts, and get the latest updates about Barber Party.

Come share your ideas, experiences, and impressions with us.

Let’s work together to create the ultimate Barber Party experience — together!

[url=https://discord.gg/k6Rg5qK2GR]Click to see your invitation to Barber Party[/url]

See you there!

[h2]RULES:[/h2]

[h3]BE RESPECTFUL[/h3]
We want everyone to feel welcome and comfortable. Respect each other and the mods. Be polite and keep it friendly and positive. Don't get involved with arguments or post inflammatory statements.

Hate speech and verbal abuse of server members will not be tolerated.

[h3]OFF-TOPIC[/h3]
Do not discuss politics or religion in the social channels. NSFW content is strictly prohibited on this server.

[h3]SELF-PROMOTION[/h3]
If you're a content creator, you can share links to your youtube videos and livestreams in the #lp-and-livestreams channel.
